content: नीविः, -वी {%f.%} [निव्ययति निवीयते वा निव्ये-इन्; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 4. 135</ls>] :-- .²1 A cloth worn round a womanʼs waist, or more properly the ends of the cloth tied into a knot in front, the knot of the wearing garment; प्रस्थानभिन्नां न बबन्ध नीविम् <ls>R. 7. 9</ls>; नीविबन्धोच्छ्वसनम् <ls>Māl. 2. 5</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 38</ls>; नीविं प्रति प्रणिहिते तु करे प्रियेण <ls>K. P. 4</ls>; <ls>Me. 70</ls>; <ls>Śi. 10. 64</ls>. .²2 The outer tie of a packet in which the offerings of a Śūdra at funeral obsequies are presented. .²3 Capital, principal, stock; नीवीमवलिखतः द्विगुणः (दण्डः) <ls>Kau. A. 2. 7</ls>; शेषमायव्ययौ नीवी च <ls>Kau. A. 2. 6</ls>. .²4 A stake, wager. .²5 Prison; नीवी स्याद्बन्धनागारे धने स्त्रीवस्त्रबन्धने <ls>Nm.</ls>
